lloyd_moments.kill_criterion: An exact nonnegative integer profile with N_0=0 satisfies all universal moments and the forced arc-vertex multiplicities.
lloyd_moments.scope: degree-two incidence moments at the first live boundary (q,k)=(53,12)
lloyd_moments.verdict: KILLED at degree two: no quadratic Lloyd/Delsarte dual polynomial using only these moments can force an uncovered point. Higher-order concurrency identities would be genuinely new input.

local_cumulants.kill_criterion: Local all-negative patterns occur with slack and the adjacent/disjoint edge mutual information or cycle biases do not yield a stable forbidden pattern.
local_cumulants.scope: all general-position 4- and 5-subsets of the off-conic plane at q=5,7

prefix_entropy.kill_criterion: At fixed depth the surviving-prefix extension counts are diffuse rather than collapsing to a small, stable catalogue of plateau values.
prefix_entropy.scope: all subsets of one exact maximum witness at q in {13,19,29,31,41,43}; extension counts impose both externality and general position

saturated_uncertainty.kill_criterion: The q=5 coherent examples are not distinguished by a sharp uncertainty gap, additive-energy signature, or exact Paley eigen-residual.
saturated_uncertainty.scope: all character candidates over prime q in {5,7,11,19,23}

split_support.kill_criterion: The missing sets have generic Hilbert functions through degree 10 and no persistent line concentration beyond their O(|S|/q) scale.
split_support.scope: maximum-coverage extremal witnesses in every audited prime field q>=13; degrees 1 through 10
